dispute.claim_text: Let me be clear about two things. One: I picked the cheap option twice and the app kept giving me a taxi. Two: the actual fare was way above the estimate. The DRIVER did nothing wrong, he followed the navigation the whole way, this is the platform's problem. Customer service kept insisting the driver detoured. He didn't!

counterparty_statement.text: Meter fare, standard route. The passenger asked before boarding and I told her it's metered. I'm on the platform's dispatch, I don't choose which bookings they give me.
